patch_description:
When total layer degrees tie, choose the layer with more eligible cohort partners already connected on the opposite layer. Exclude self and remembered failures, and retain layer 0 when counts tie. The counting step consumes no randomness; existing reservoir sampling remains unchanged.
This targets recovery states where external ties or failed partners make equally populated layers offer different overlap opportunities. It may accelerate spillover accumulation during cohort construction. Partner selection remains uniform within the chosen layer’s eligible pool, so overlap is not guaranteed. The change could also delay useful triangle closure. Partition arithmetic, acceptance, pruning, memory and phase transitions retain their current behavior.
This proposal is unevaluated. Improvement requires an authorized full-panel comparison, assessed across the 36 history families and available shocked/unshocked outcomes.
